title: Palladyne AI To Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Palladyne AI CEO Ben Wolff and CFO Trevor Thatcher will participate in the Jefferies and Lake Street BIG10 investor conferences, Sept. 9-10, 2026.
body_markdown:
**SALT LAKE CITY — August 31, 2026 —**[Palladyne AI](https://www.palladyneai.com/) **(NASDAQ: PDYN)** , a U.S.-based aerospace, defense and industrial technology company delivering embodied AI-powered collaborative autonomy solutions, advanced avionics, precision-manufactured components, UAVs, and advanced aerospace engineering services, announced today that Ben Wolff, CEO, and Trevor Thatcher, CFO will participate in two upcoming conferences.


**Jefferies Global Industrials Conference**


**Date:** Wednesday September 9, 2026
**Format:** Fireside Chat with Ben Wolff, hosted by Jefferies analyst Adam Samuelson
**Time:** 8:10 to 8:45 AM ET
**Webcast:**[https://summitcast.meetmax.com/view/e82pfcbT4UwH79PoqVE5jB/cLqaVYiX62XtBS5B3pxmw2?ukey=7b26c3f18984a5a1873cdd8774309332](https://summitcast.meetmax.com/view/e82pfcbT4UwH79PoqVE5jB/cLqaVYiX62XtBS5B3pxmw2?ukey=7b26c3f18984a5a1873cdd8774309332)


**Lake Street Capital Markets 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth Conference (“BIG10”)**


**Date:** Thursday September 10, 2026
**Format:** 1:1 meeting conference
**Attending:** Ben Wolff and Trevor Thatcher


Qualified investors should contact their Jefferies and Lake Street representatives to set up 1:1 meetings with management.


**About Palladyne AI**
Palladyne AI is a U.S.-based technology company developing patented embodied artificial intelligence, collaborative autonomy solutions, and autonomous systems for defense and industrial markets. Palladyne AI delivers secure, American-developed and operated platforms designed to meet the stringent requirements of U.S. government and public-sector customers, including data sovereignty, security, and compliance. Palladyne AI’s embodied AI is designed to operate in complex, contested, and high-risk environments, enabling distributed tasking, human-on-the-loop decision-making, degraded-communications resilience, and multi-domain coordination. Its platform-agnostic autonomy stack combines real-time sensor fusion, adaptive AI models, and edge-native orchestration to support autonomous and collaborative systems across air, ground, maritime, and industrial domains. For more information about Palladyne AI, including GuideTech and Palladyne Aerospace and Defense, please visit[www.palladyneai.com](https://usg02.safelinks.protection.office365.us/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.palladyneai.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cnick.iverson%40palladyneai.com%7C42fb7ba210e34fbfa08008dec73ab411%7C61f0e4206be74f9a85200a17ad0b9bdd%7C0%7C0%7C639167252129545268%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=47GHCm8KnfSPGeuYeC%2BUT9a9KUd46fkT%2BLmiu5bTJOM%3D&reserved=0) .
